E:\THOTH\THOTH3.HTM
The Knight of Wands represents the fiery part of Fire; he rules from the 21St degree of Scorpio to the 20th degree of Sagittarius.
The moral qualities appropriate to this figure are activity, generosity, fierceness, impetuosity, pride, rashness, and sudden generosity.
In the Yi King, the fiery part of Fire is represented by the 51st
P.152
hexagram, Kan. The signification there given is entirely in accordance with the doctrine of this card.
